summary: Admit advisory immutable standard propagation requests

delivery.outcome: Replace direct unadmitted fleet upgrade writes with closed advisory requests bound to a verified immutable standard release.
nonGoals: No canonical tag or Release creation in this source slice
No target clone, ticket allocation, adoption, branch, PR or merge from this workflow
No organization-wide credential provisioning or controller/runtime deployment
No claim that emitting a request proves execution readiness or fleet rollout

architecture.decision: The standard hub owns the immutable request contract and read-only workflow adapter. Existing protected product controllers remain the only execution authority; Goal transaction libraries are not treated as deployed authorization providers.
interfaceChanges: Advisory request schema with executionAuthorized=false and no implicit targets
Legacy propagation workflow emits verified requests; unadmitted live dispatch refuses
CI includes focused propagation request and workflow boundary regressions
dataChanges: Closed request records bind canonical version, annotated tag revision, final Release and immutable package tool hashes
architecture.rollback: Revert the reviewed source change through protected review; do not restore unadmitted target writes or replay uncertain effects.

validation.evidence: Real Git fixtures and mocked external publication transport: exact tag/release/version hashes, malformed input, stale or absent tags, modified pins, safe shell argument handling and no authority claims.
Workflow boundary: no broad token, org scan, target checkout, unpinned pip install, direct upgrade/PR creation or HEAD fallback; live request refusal and artifact-only success are explicit.

commands: Independent protected required CI and Validator for exact candidate HEAD
validation.evidence: Complete staged-path and committed-head gates, atomic0.20.103 projections, bounded docs and independent protected source publication.
